links.passage: In this regard, drip irrigation is acknowledged and used as a highly effective water-saving technique in agriculture. By delivering water straight to the roots of the plants, this technique reduces evaporation and runoff, which is especially advantageous in water scare areas (Mansingh et al., 2023).

In summary, the integration of MNB technology in DIS’s demonstrates substantial potential in addressing key agronomic and environmental challenges. Notably, MNB-enhanced ADI systems exhibit strong anti-clogging capabilities, alleviate root zone hypoxia, enhance plant physiological performance, and positively modulate the soil microbial community, thereby improving WUE.
